projects.title: FoodDash | Ad Analytics & Performance Dashboard
projects.description: A high-performance advertising analytics platform for tracking campaign effectiveness and merchant performance. Built with React and a powerful in-memory SQL engine (AlaSQL) for real-time data processing and interactive visualizations.

projects.title: BlitzTracker | AI-Powered Product Hunt Analysis
projects.description: A high-performance analytics dashboard that leverages Google's Gemini AI to score daily Product Hunt launches against Blitzscaling principles. Features 6-dimensional AI scoring, premium data visualization, and real-time sync.

projects.title: Auto-Niche | AI-Driven Affiliate Micro-SaaS
projects.description: A cutting-edge affiliate marketing platform fusing Gemini 2.5 AI creativity with real-time retailer intelligence. Features live Keepa-style price tracking, multi-API fusion (Rainforest/Best Buy), and high-fidelity review generation.

projects.title: GCPLens | Premium GCP Usage & Location Insights Dashboard
projects.description: A high-end, futuristic dashboard designed to visualize Google Cloud resource usage, costs, and service health across global locations. Built with a focus on 'Vibrant' aesthetics and glassmorphism.

projects.title: Emo Narrator | AI-Powered Emotional Voice Generator
projects.description: A full-stack TypeScript application that brings text to life using emotional AI voices from ElevenLabs. Features real-time text-to-speech conversion with emotional context, request metrics tracking in AWS DynamoDB, and a modern Next.js interface.

projects.title: LunchDeals AI | GPS-Based Lunch Specials Finder
projects.description: A real-time discovery engine that automatically detects your GPS location to find the best lunch specials and discounts within a 15-mile radius. Features real-time scraping with Firecrawl, powerful filtering by cuisine and dietary needs, and dual view mode with interactive maps.

projects.title: Curri | Driver Engagement & Sentiment Dashboard
projects.description: A high-performance logistics analytics platform designed to monitor driver retention, sentiment mapping, and operational pilots. Built with Next.js 15 and Recharts for real-time fleet insights.

projects.title: Axel | AI Coding Assistant & CLI Agent
projects.description: A lightweight CLI coding agent powered by a FastAPI/GCP backend. Features model-agnostic architecture with Vertex AI integration, specialized Fill-In-the-Middle (FIM) endpoints, and seamless model swapping without client-side changes.

projects.title: Axel's Binance Trader Bot | Real-Time Crypto Terminal
projects.description: An institutional-grade trading bot with real-time WebSocket architecture for zero-latency price updates. Implements EMA Crossover, Bollinger Bands, and MACD strategies with automated risk management and a sleek glassmorphism dashboard.
